problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 20 different infrastructure projects to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The profile for each project is given below:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.195, environmental impact 0.206, allocation limits [0.065, 0.869]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.025, environmental impact 0.149, allocation limits [0.041, 0.725]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.179, environmental impact 0.086, allocation limits [0.005, 0.455]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.052, environmental impact 0.287, allocation limits [0.041, 0.609]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.062, environmental impact 0.062, allocation limits [0.071, 0.669]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.085, environmental impact 0.125, allocation limits [0.011, 0.823]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.110, environmental impact 0.160, allocation limits [0.078, 0.561]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.020, environmental impact 0.041, allocation limits [0.087, 0.579]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.128, environmental impact 0.244, allocation limits [0.048, 0.324]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.092, environmental impact 0.110, allocation limits [0.075, 0.821]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.034, environmental impact 0.222, allocation limits [0.069, 0.576]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.061, environmental impact 0.200, allocation limits [0.081, 0.330]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.110, environmental impact 0.127, allocation limits [0.094, 0.660]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.028, environmental impact 0.244, allocation limits [0.011, 0.522]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.074, environmental impact 0.057, allocation limits [0.017, 0.555]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.037, environmental impact 0.047, allocation limits [0.041, 0.705]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.089, environmental impact 0.157, allocation limits [0.073, 0.760]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.052, environmental impact 0.209, allocation limits [0.084, 0.314]  
* Project S: benefit score 0.047, environmental impact 0.013, allocation limits [0.008, 0.460]  
* Project T: benefit score 0.076, environmental impact 0.200, allocation limits [0.001, 0.476]  

Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified allocation limits, and the sum of all fractions must equal one. To ensure timely completion, the set of high-priority projects L = {A, B, D, F, G, I, J, K, L, N, O, P, Q, T} must collectively receive at least 0.651 of the total budget. Additionally, the total environmental impact of all projects must not exceed 0.207, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.049. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
